t: This block will receive a redstone signal from a linked redstone transmitter. To link this receiver with a transmitter right-select the transmitter (or another linked receiver) with this block. Enabling 'analog mode' causes the power level of transmitted signals to be preserved at the receiving end
这个方块会从已链接的红石发射器接收红石信号。要将此接收器与发射器链接，请用该方块对发射器（或另一个已链接的接收器）进行右键选择。启用“模拟模式”后，传输信号的功率等级会在接收端得到保留。
Use a $(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_transmitter)Redstone Transmitter$(/l) or a Button Module in a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)Screen$(/l) to send redstone signals
使用一个$(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_transmitter)红石信号发信器$(/l)或一个按钮模块，将其放入$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)屏幕$(/l)中以发送红石信号
